g.text: Aegis: p90 forecast coverage 90.0% on 20 unseen Azure apps // Aegis: 38.8 kWh less than Cluster Autoscaler at 0% shortfall // NeuroOS student: 7 to 24% lower mean wait than MLFQ on heavy-tailed loads // Digital twin: detector F1 0.978 falls to about 0.1 past 5 s of staleness // Sonar: mAP@0.5 80.7%, 44.6 ms per frame on CPU // Network twin: root cause top-1 84.6% on single faults // Weather blend: 7.9% better rain RMSE, 6.2% better wind RMSE than naive //
